description:
Why are owl wings COMPLETELY silent? 🦉 Owls have three secret feather tricks that kill noise at the source — serrated leading edges, velvety surfaces, and fringed trailing edges. Their prey never hears them coming.

How do owls fly silently? The secret is in the feathers.
